⚠️ Pre-Launch Known Defects (Root Causes)

DEFECT D-01 — Thermostatic Switches (SRC-02)

O₂ Tank 2 switches were rated for 28V DC but KSC ground equipment applied 65V DC during pre-flight testing on March 27, 1969 — burning out the switches silently.

DEFECT D-02 — Fill Tube Assembly (SRC-02)

Fill tube was incorrectly reinstalled after Beech Aircraft rework (1965), preventing proper draining during ground tests.

DEFECT D-03 — 8-Hour Heater Burn at 65V (SRC-02)

To drain Tank 2, engineers boiled off oxygen with the heater at 65V for 8 hours on March 27, 1970 — this further degraded the Teflon wiring insulation.

DEFECT D-04 — Invisible Insulation Damage (SRC-02)

Damaged wiring was invisible to pre-flight inspection. Only became a fire hazard when fans energized inside the pure O₂ environment during the mission.
